stress_metric: MTM loss / Tier1 + runnable funding share
trigger_rule: forced funding/failure gate = (loss/T1 >= threshold AND runnable share >= threshold) OR one-day outflow >= threshold
slope: 3-day outflow = 10/25/60% of runnable deposits after trigger; forced sale fraction = 10/25/50% of uncovered liquidity gap
overlap_guard: MTM is state variable only; direct loss not additive D. Deposit flight is liquidity transfer unless it causes incremental forced-sale deadweight or credit-supply contraction.

stress_metric: inventory MTM / equity proxy + repo haircut margin + VaR utilization
trigger_rule: forced de-risk if MTM/equity proxy exceeds forced threshold or repo margin call exceeds liquidity buffer while VaR/utilization binds
slope: forced sale 5/15/35% of inventory per +100bp-month above trigger; market depth remains 75/50/25% of normal when VaR binds
overlap_guard: Dealer fire-sale price impact feeds future price/yield diagnostics; not direct household wealth or borrower default D.

stress_metric: collateral buffer bp consumed + delivery delay
low: 250bp minimum; forced sale 20% of margin gap
base: 300-350bp resilience midpoint; forced sale 50% of gap
trigger_rule: LDI trigger when cumulative rate shock consumes available buffer or collateral cannot be delivered within five days
slope: asset sale share applies only to leveraged LDI sleeve, not all pensions; U.S. sleeve range 2/5/10% of pension fixed-income duration exposure
overlap_guard: Collateral posting is transfer; count only incremental forced-sale price impact/deadweight after excluding direct pension wealth MTM.

stress_metric: asset MTM loss / statutory surplus proxy + nontraditional liability runoff
trigger_rule: capital/ratings/liquidity trigger, not daily redemption; forced-sale only if losses plus runoff exhaust cash/ST and liability-matching buffer
slope: severe runoff share of $531bn life-insurer nontraditional liabilities; forced sale after liquid assets consumed
overlap_guard: Insurer MTM not direct household 6C wealth drag here; insurer liability payments/credit supply effects need separate promoted evidence.

stress_metric: NAV loss -> outflow share + cash/liquid buffer
low: core 0.05% outflow per 1% NAV loss; watch 3%; forced 7%; buffer 3%
trigger_rule: monthly outflow over cash/liquid buffer becomes forced sale; HY/loan and illiquid funds use higher flow-performance sensitivity
slope: forced sale = max(0, outflow - cash/liquid buffer), with liquid-first collar before less-liquid assets
overlap_guard: Fund NAV MTM already in bond diagnostic include_flag=0; holder-stress layer counts only incremental forced-sale price impact and no direct spending wealth drag unless future 6C gate promotes it.
